description: Get real-time US-regulated crypto quotes from Robinhood: best bid/ask (inclusive of spread) per trading pair, sourced from the official Robinhood Crypto Trading API and proxied read-only by the MPP32 backend. Useful as a regulated-venue price reference alongside on-chain sources (Jupiter, DexScreener). Symbols use Robinhood pair format like BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD, DOGE-USD. Free — no payment required. Returns an explanatory error if the MPP32 deployment has not configured Robinhood credentials.

symbols.description: Trading pairs to quote, e.g. ["BTC-USD", "ETH-USD"]. 1–20 symbols.

name: get_robinhood_crypto_quotes
